title: Ender Bricks
description: Fixes enderman farm overflow in the simplest way possible.
body:
We've all been there. Your pickaxe is on death's door and you still have another half of the mountain to deal with. You head to your enderman farm and grind XP for a minute or two...

...And then your hoppers stop collecting. Your game's not lagging, you're just out of space. Annoying, isn't it? That's why I made this mod. So you can do what any rational Minecrafter would do and turn them into blocks! Or, you can just be silly and kill the dragon by throwing bricks at them. Your choice.
